explanation_full: The Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) ranking identifies the relative importance of various features for the model. According to the ranking, VFA has the highest score (0.7931), indicating it is the most influential feature. Butyrate follows closely with a score of 0.7902, and Acetate ranks third with a score of 0.7772. The remaining features, VSS (0.7768), Propionate (0.7596), and Ethanol (0.7329), follow in descending order of importance.
